invariants.statement: No write-capable action is AUTHORIZED with an empty target-path set.
A candidate never selects the authoritative base used to enumerate its diff.
ACTION_SCOPE cannot expand the trusted maximum or drop mandatory forbidden patterns.
An in-progress stage ACTION_SCOPE cannot change after its introduction commit.
Local evidence metadata cannot establish acceptance without matching official GitHub run and PR metadata.
Historical governance acceptance entries are append-only and hash chained.
A pull request cannot replace the verifier that judges that same pull request, and root-critical judge files are immutable under ordinary post-bootstrap amendments.
main without externally verified protection is a blocking governance failure.
Release authorization is derived from complete accepted stages, exact bindings and release/final verifiers; a boolean alone is insufficient.
A future stage with undefined root maximum scope is REJECT by default.
No runtime, product claim, product test or historical normative document may be modified by CS016E.
